events.text:
I fixed `tax()` in `src/invoice.py`. I couldn't run the tests, so CI will have to confirm it.

The old code floored the result, so 112.50 × 0.09 = 10.125 came out as 10.12. Finance policy FIN-12 (quoted in the test) says to round half up to the cent, and the test expects 10.13.

`tax()` now uses `Decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. It converts the inputs through `str`, which avoids binary floating-point error on exact half-cent values like 10.125. I didn't change the test.

This changes the rounding for every invoice, not just this one. Any amount that used to be floored will now round to the nearest cent, so some totals will come out a cent higher. That matches FIN-12, but it's worth a quick check before the 3pm release.
